component.name: Battleship
Bataille Navale
component.summary: Sink the pirate fleet before it sinks yours
Coulez la flotte pirate avant qu'elle ne coule la vôtre

description.p: The classic pen-and-paper game against the computer, on a 10 by 10 grid with a fleet of ten ships that may not touch each other.

ul.li: Three levels, from a random gunner to one that reasons on probabilities
Random fleet placement, redrawn as often as you like before the first shot
Keyboard and mouse play, optional sound effects

description.p: Complete rewrite: MVC architecture, tested game engine, new computer opponent.
